body:
Cloud setup handoff

Intended recipient: Astra 6.1 Max Orchestrator completion.

Owner instruction: Ask this lead all questions for this task and going forward. They lead this small team and should ask the owner questions when necessary. Reuse existing credentials. Target a new isolated cloud profile; connect all supported integrations without bypassing application gates.

Delivery status: Not sent. The cloud session can read the lead thread but has no cross-thread message tool or access to its Windows filesystem.

Questions for the lead

  1. Where are the existing provider and Slack credential bindings, and what supported secure mechanism can bind them into this cloud environment? Do not send values in chat.
  2. Which distinct Slack app/channel and owner identity should the new isolated profile use?
  3. Which existing Claude routine and authenticated host bridge endpoints should it use? Which signed provider activation, independent review/CI/security evidence, entitlement and budget authority records apply to this new profile?

Completed

Repository: /workspace/director-orchestrator. Python 3.12 virtualenv and requirements installed. PowerShell 7.4.13 verified against official SHA256; repository-owned PostgreSQL test lane started. Firecrawl CLI 1.23.3 installed. Local FastAPI health, unauthorized rejection, authenticated dry-run intake, persisted plan and owner-decision gate passed. Persistence/recovery probe passed twice. Isolated n8n and PostgreSQL services started; readiness and UI HTTP requests passed. No tracked repository changes.

Credentials and blockers

GitHub Git read works via platform authentication. GitHub API reads return Forbidden. Standard provider credential files are absent. All nine provider/Slack secret declarations report no saved binding. Existing Codex runtime authentication is not an application API credential and was not extracted. The generated local service secrets are private in /workspace/director-cloud/local.env and are not provider credentials.

Live preflight identifies 23 unmet requirements; full report: /workspace/director-cloud/live-preflight.txt. Saved draft includes install_script, start_skill, isolated-profile variable requirements and nine proxy credential requirements. These are declarations only, not new accounts or keys. Draft is not published. OPENAI_* is reserved; DIRECTOR_OPENAI_API_KEY is the proxy binding alias. Slack Socket Mode and CLI proxy compatibility require validation after existing credentials are bound.

Validation

Initial full run: 4385 tests, 2 failures, 1 error, 157 skips. The two PowerShell discovery failures passed after adding its directory to PATH. A full rerun with that setup is in progress; results: /workspace/director-cloud/tests-final.log. Remaining diagnosed compatibility issue: Docker Compose 2.40.3 renders bind.create_host_path=false as bind={}, while scripts/director-release.py requires the explicit false property; test_director_release.ReleasePreparationTests.test_sibling_guard_consumes_actual_compose_rendering rejects this rendering. Source was not changed.
